description.summary: NGF•BTC•AM is the declared utility Rune of the NESGESFinance ecosystem on Bitcoin L1. Its stated functions are digital identity, technical access, functional participation, advisory governance, and unit-of-account reference; it does not grant direct economic rights over project series.
use_cases: Digital identity within the NESGESFinance ecosystem
Technical access key for platform modules and launchpad flows
Functional participation in authorized on-chain processes
Internal unit-of-account reference for thresholds and fees

state_model.internal_ledger_policy: Any exchange or application ledger must reconcile strictly against Bitcoin transactions, Rune balances, and independently verifiable evidence.
state_model.unsupported_model: NGF•BTC•AM must not be modeled as an ERC-20-style balance[address] system without a deterministic Rune indexer.

supply.vesting_policy: allocation lock-up only; no additional minting, with a 6-month cliff followed by 12-18 months of linear release where applicable
supply.distribution_status: declared at 100% with public verification and audit references

custody.model: multi-signature 3-of-5 coordinated with PSBT (BIP 174); address/script evidence pending
custody.implementation_stage: design declaration; production deployment is not evidenced by this repository
custody.signing_flow: Authenticated request, policy/risk review, PSBT construction, external signer quorum, finalization, and Bitcoin broadcast
custody.private_key_policy: Private keys must not be handled in browser code.
custody.rotation_policy: semiannual signer rotation with public custody log

audit_and_transparency.proof_of_reserves: evidence model pending; not a static certification
audit_and_transparency.audit_policy: technical audit phase, connector testing, and periodic evidence review

evidence_status_definitions.VERIFIED_ONCHAIN: Directly verified against Bitcoin mainnet or another stated on-chain source.
evidence_status_definitions.VERIFIED_SOURCE: Verified against the canonical source file or Git object in this repository.
evidence_status_definitions.VERIFIED_BUILD: Verified through a reproducible build or validation command.
evidence_status_definitions.VERIFIED_RUNTIME: Verified in a running system or integration environment.
evidence_status_definitions.DOCUMENTED: Documented in repository materials but not independently verified in this repository.
evidence_status_definitions.DECLARED: Declared by project metadata or institutional documents without independent evidence attached here.
evidence_status_definitions.SIMULATED: Established only by simulation or test fixture.
evidence_status_definitions.CONTRADICTED: Contradicted by stronger evidence and requiring correction or explanation.

ngf_genesis_audit_record.source_of_truth_policy: TXID, confirmed Bitcoin block, and deterministic Rune indexer output supersede PDF, HTML, or prose transcriptions.
forensic_verification_steps: Fetch raw transaction by TXID from a trusted Bitcoin Core node or indexer.
Confirm containing block hash, height, timestamp, and transaction index.
Decode the Runestone and reconstruct etching terms.
Confirm Rune ID, symbol, supply, divisibility, premine, mint terms, and burn semantics.
Reconstruct UTXO distribution and outpoint-level Rune balances.
Record each claim in evidence_matrix with the strongest available evidence status.
current_limitations: This repository does not include a Bitcoin Core node, ord/runes indexer, or blocks.ts source module.
On-chain values remain DOCUMENTED until verified against an external or local canonical Bitcoin/Rune source.
The etching.op_return field is preserved as literal declared metadata and is interpreted through separate evidence notes.
